description.value: Origin Bakery & Cafe is a 100% dedicated gluten-free bakery and cafe with two Victoria-area locations, founded in 2009 and now expanding through franchising. The Langford (Belmont) branch offers a full range of fresh baked goods including breads, breakfast items, lunch, cakes, pastries, and cookies, made using over 20 alternative gluten-free flour substitutes. Touring cyclists with celiac disease or gluten sensitivities will find a rare dedicated safe-space bakery that also accommodates dairy-free, egg-free, nut-free, and soy-free diets.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record's addr:unit '105' matches the Belmont Location (#105 - 3039 Merchant Way, Langford, BC) listed on the website's contact page, confirming this record corresponds to the Langford branch rather than the Victoria Pandora location. The website is fully active with online ordering, delivery service, and detailed product listings, confirming the business is open. No cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking, water refill, or washrooms are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Victoria' but addr:unit 105 and coordinates correspond to the Belmont Location at 3039 Merchant Way, Langford, BC — a separate municipality.
OSM had no phone or address fields populated; both were sourced from the website contact page for the Langford/Belmont location and cannot be cross-checked against OSM values.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible specialty bakery and cafe with a confirmed physical Langford location. A notable stop for touring cyclists requiring gluten-free food options.

wow_evidence: 100% dedicated gluten-free bakery and cafe with two Victoria-area locations, founded in 2009 and now expanding through franchising
